The routes `codify serve` answers, read from the checked-in contract [`contract/openapi.json`](../../contract/openapi.json) (version `0.7.0`). `codify serve --openapi` prints the same schema. Each group links to the guide page that uses it.

### DocumentPlacedTable

A table outside every provision, with the eIds it sits under (outermost
first) so a reader can place it and a subtree read can keep it.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ancestor_eids` | array of string |  |  |
| `heading` | string or null |  |  |
| `table` | [DocumentTable](#documenttable) | required |  |

### DocumentProvision

Leaf-level legal text, paragraph / subparagraph / point.

`text` remains the plain-text shadow for search / fallback rendering;
`blocks` is the rich AST built from the AKN sub-tree.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `akn_eid` | string | required |  |
| `akn_type` | string | required |  |
| `blocks` | array of [DocumentProvisionBlock](#documentprovisionblock) |  |  |
| `id` | string (uuid) | required |  |
| `normative` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `num` | string or null |  |  |
| `position` | integer | required |  |
| `text` | string | required |  |

### DocumentProvisionBlock

One row in a nested-provision tree (paragraph / subparagraph / …).

Carries its own number, optional heading, intro inline run, nested
blocks, and trailing wrap-up so renderers can present a hanging
numbered hierarchy rather than a flattened paragraph. `table` is set
(and everything else empty) when `akn_type == "table"`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `akn_eid` | string | required |  |
| `akn_type` | string | required |  |
| `blocks` | array of [DocumentProvisionBlock](#documentprovisionblock) |  |  |
| `heading` | string or null |  |  |
| `intro` | array of [InlineText](#inlinetext) or [InlineAnchor](#inlineanchor) or [InlineRef](#inlineref) or [InlineTerm](#inlineterm) or [InlineCitation](#inlinecitation) or [InlineEmph](#inlineemph) or [InlineStrong](#inlinestrong) or [InlineMod](#inlinemod) or [InlineNote](#inlinenote) |  |  |
| `num` | string or null |  |  |
| `table` | [DocumentTable](#documenttable) or null |  |  |
| `wrap_up` | array of [InlineText](#inlinetext) or [InlineAnchor](#inlineanchor) or [InlineRef](#inlineref) or [InlineTerm](#inlineterm) or [InlineCitation](#inlinecitation) or [InlineEmph](#inlineemph) or [InlineStrong](#inlinestrong) or [InlineMod](#inlinemod) or [InlineNote](#inlinenote) |  |  |

### DocumentSection

Hierarchical container, title / chapter / part / article / etc.

Holds child sections and provisions in their persisted `position` order.
Top-level provisions (those without an enclosing section) hang off the
`VersionDocument.provisions` list instead.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `akn_eid` | string | required |  |
| `akn_type` | string | required |  |
| `id` | string (uuid) | required |  |
| `num` | string or null |  |  |
| `position` | integer | required |  |
| `provisions` | array of [DocumentProvision](#documentprovision) |  |  |
| `sections` | array of [DocumentSection](#documentsection) |  |  |
| `title` | string or null | required |  |

### DocumentTable

An AKN `<table>`, eId-keyed like every other citable unit.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `akn_eid` | string | required |  |
| `rows` | array of [DocumentTableRow](#documenttablerow) |  |  |

### DocumentTableCell

One `<th>`/`<td>`; `content` is the same inline AST as any other cell of
legal text, so refs/terms/citations inside a table cell still render.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `akn_eid` | string or null |  |  |
| `colspan` | integer | `1` |  |
| `content` | array of [InlineText](#inlinetext) or [InlineAnchor](#inlineanchor) or [InlineRef](#inlineref) or [InlineTerm](#inlineterm) or [InlineCitation](#inlinecitation) or [InlineEmph](#inlineemph) or [InlineStrong](#inlinestrong) or [InlineMod](#inlinemod) or [InlineNote](#inlinenote) |  |  |
| `header` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `rowspan` | integer | `1` |  |

### DocumentTableRow

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `akn_eid` | string or null |  |  |
| `cells` | array of [DocumentTableCell](#documenttablecell) |  |  |
